snippet.title: Medieval Juice Crafter | Trailer
snippet.description:
Medieval Juice Crafter is a simulation game where you sell your special recipe juices in medieval villages.

Craft your special recipe juices and sell them in medieval villages. Expand your business with new recipes, machines, properties, and workers. Play online with your friend or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your business.
